body:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>, Isabelle Laurent <isabelle.laurent@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Jan 13, 2025 at 9:12 AM
Subject: Field rollout plan: Redwood Standard Demo v1 (training + assets)

Soojin — want to lock the NA field rollout for “Standard Demo v1” this week.

Can you confirm:
1) Training session(s): I’m proposing Thu 11:00–12:00 PT (live dry run + Q&A). Optional office hours the following Tue 10:30–11:00 PT.
2) Required assets that must be ready by EOD Wed so managers can enforce usage:
   - Final deck (no pricing numbers, persona callouts)
   - Speaker notes / talk track (incl. security branch)
   - Demo tenant reset checklist (pre/post)
   - Security FAQ (demo-tenant specific)
   - “Known-good scenarios” matrix + plan B steps
   - Objection handling (competitive, what we show live vs claim)
   - 2-minute mini-demo variant (hosted API quick hit)
3) Ownership/where to point reps: Drive vs Confluence vs internal docs.

Also: Isabelle is asking for a crisp CRM workflow line (when to use the demo tenant vs spinning up a prospect trial). Can you add 2–3 bullets we can include in the rollout email?

If you can send the final training agenda + links, I’ll have NA managers push attendance and make this “required” for anyone doing platform/security demos.

Thanks,
Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
VP Sales, North America
Redwood Inference


---

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>, Isabelle Laurent <isabelle.laurent@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Jan 13, 2025 at 11:03 AM
Subject: Re: Field rollout plan: Redwood Standard Demo v1 (training + assets)

Yes — Thu 11–12 PT works. I can also do the office hours next Tue.

Assets status (what will be ready by Wed EOD):
- Deck: ready for “Standard Demo v1” final export Wed (we’re swapping in the final Console screenshots from the latest tenant).
- Talk track: master script is stable; I’ll publish the “platform eng” and “security” branches as separate sections with timeboxes.
- Security FAQ: Naomi already reviewed; I’ll make sure the demo tenant specifics (retention/logging) are explicit and consistent.
- Objection handling: I’m cleaning up the competitive notes to separate “show” vs “say” (no unverified benchmark numbers).

On “2-minute mini-demo”: I’m okay to include it as a named variant, but I’d like Markus to sanity check that we’re not removing the differentiators.

Re: CRM workflow bullets — suggestion for rollout email:
- Use Standard Demo tenant for first-call platform/security deep dives and multi-stakeholder meetings (reliability + consistent screenshots).
- Create a prospect trial only after: success criteria + target traffic shape are confirmed, AND they need to test prompts/data (owned by SE).
- Any request for “custom model” or “unique integration” should be deferred to eval/POC, not live demo.

I’ll send links + agenda once I drop the final docs.

Soojin
Soojin Lee
Director, Product Marketing
Redwood Inference


---

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>, Isabelle Laurent <isabelle.laurent@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Jan 13, 2025 at 12:26 PM
Subject: Re: Field rollout plan: Redwood Standard Demo v1 (training + assets)

+1 on keeping the mini-demo, but we should define it tightly:
- 2 minutes: streaming chat + “cost/latency” dashboard screenshot (not live clickpath)
- If prospect leans platform/security, we immediately graduate to the full Standard Demo (routing/fallback + observability)

For training agenda, I recommend:
1) What to qualify (persona + what to run first)
2) Live run-through (driver vs narrator roles)
3) How to handle nondeterminism (canned prompts/expected outputs)
4) “Plan B” if demo tenant is degraded (screenshots + recorded clip link)
5) Close: next steps to eval (what we need from the prospect)

Talia — can you add 5 mins on “how to file issues / what info to capture” so we stop losing time in Slack?

Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference


---

From: Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Isabelle Laurent <isabelle.laurent@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jan 14, 2025 at 8:41 AM
Subject: Re: Field rollout plan: Redwood Standard Demo v1 (training + assets)

Yep — I’ll add a 5-min “how to get help” segment:
- Pre-demo checklist (dashboards green, quota reset)
- During demo: if anything looks off, pivot to Plan B slide + keep narrative going
- Issue filing: Jira INT ticket template + include tenant region, timestamp, route/model, request ID

Also attaching a first draft of:
1) rollout email (field enablement note + required links)
2) LMS outline (30-min self-paced recap + certification checklist)

Attachment: Field Enablement Email + LMS Outline - Standard Demo v1 (Draft).docx
Attachment: Standard Demo v1 - AE-SE Certification Checklist (Draft).pdf

If we want max attendance, I suggest we explicitly call out who must attend:
- All NA AEs
- All NA SEs
- Any SDR who schedules platform/security demos

Talia
Talia Benson
Program Manager, GTM Enablement
Redwood Inference

From: Isabelle Laurent <isabelle.laurent@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Field rollout plan: Redwood Standard Demo v1 (training + assets)

Adding the CRM workflow language I’d like in the rollout email (so reps don’t improvise):

In HubSpot:
- Log “Standard Demo v1” as the demo type (so we can measure demo→eval conversion)
- If the prospect asks to test with their own data or needs a specific region/Private constraints, convert to “Evaluation/Trial” and hand off to SE for trial request
- If the meeting is primarily security/procurement, attach the Demo Tenant Security FAQ in the follow-up email and tag “Security Review Started”

Soojin — if you’re okay, I’ll provide the exact property names for the LMS module + rollout email.

Isabelle
Isabelle Laurent
Sales Operations (CRM Workflow)
Redwood Inference

Locked.

Soojin/Talia — please send me the final links by tomorrow 9am PT so managers can include them in team standups.

Plan:
- Thu 11:00–12:00 PT: mandatory training (NA AE/SE)
- Tue 10:30–11:00 PT: office hours

Rollout email must include (minimum):
- “Standard Demo v1” deck link + speaker notes
- Demo tenant access instructions + reset checklist
- Security FAQ link
- Issue filing instructions (Talia’s section)
- CRM workflow bullets (Isabelle’s property names)

Jordan — looping you in for visibility. We’ll keep pricing out of the deck; reps will point to ranges and route procurement requests to the security package.

Stephanie
